comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: All markdown files under `docs/` are validated by `scripts/docs_validator.py` and must start with YAML frontmatter (it errors on missing frontmatter). This new DR pack lacks frontmatter, so `python scripts/docs_validator.py` / pre-commit will fail. Add the required frontmatter block (or run `python scripts/docs_frontmatter_guard.py --fix`) for this file and the other new files in `docs/research/mcp-customization/`.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: `scripts/docs_validator.py` treats filenames matching `README*.md` as prohibited (`PROHIBITED_PATTERNS` includes `README`). `docs/research/mcp-customization/README_UPLOAD_ORDER.md` will therefore fail docs validation even if frontmatter is added. Please rename this file to a non-README name (and update any references + `MANIFEST.sha256` accordingly).
